name: research-rag
description: Local-first literature RAG for Zotero PDF libraries — domain-pack architecture, 5 LLM backends, and 10 search workflow families.

plugins.name: research-rag
plugins.description: Generate structured research notes from Zotero PDFs and search them through 10 workflow families. The default domain pack is catalysis; bootstrap_domain_pack.py creates packs for other fields.
